description: ONNX export: pre-NMS graph plus Python preprocess and postprocess.

input.name: images
input.value_range: already (x/255 - mean) / std using training normalize_mean / normalize_std
input.spatial: Fixed H,W from export (1024x1024 for this repo).

outputs.pre_nms_count: scalar live count (includes zeroed invalid slots)

preprocess.steps: RGB uint8 → bilinear resize to target_size → /255 → subtract mean / divide std → NCHW

postprocess.impl: export.nms (copied to onnx_export/ at export; python clip or shapely)
postprocess.steps: score floor → rotated NMS → max_detections_per_image; then scale boxes to original image size

rotated_fcos_pre_nms.notes: Primary delivery. GroupNorm stays in the graph. NMS is Python.

rotated_rtmdet_pre_nms.notes: CSPNeXt + SepBN head + DistanceAnglePointCoder decode. NMS is Python.

faster_rcnn_pre_nms.notes: ROI decode in ONNX. NMS in Python.

rotated_fcos_heads.notes: Head maps only (no decode). Prefer rotated_fcos_pre_nms.
